answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 48 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a knoll bet on surviving 48 epochs of grading, and every river settlement recomputes the sable schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 7 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 33 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
